description: This Java source file defines the `LogFragment` class, a fragment that manages a log view for displaying log messages within an Android application. It inflates a layout containing a scrollable, monospace text view, and sets up a text watcher to auto-scroll when new log data is appended.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log messages in a scrollable text view, automatically scrolling to the latest logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance. Returns the root view containing the log view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when logs are updated, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
